svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: The Wine-Dark Sea
svg.desc: the isles of the wanderings, from Troy to Ithaca, as the poem has them — generated by tools/draw-map.mjs from data/maps/wine-dark-sea.json. A terrain wash per hex, the ground texture that terrain prints in, a shoreline with wave lines beside it, the watercourses run downhill from the high ground, the settlements and the lanes between them, in a timber frame with a lettered index. The hex grid is a hairline here and an overlay at read time from the same rows, so the two cannot disagree.
